raw_segments.text: Father Farrapont never went to see the Elder.
Though he lived in the Hermitage, they did not worry him to keep its regulations, and
this too because he behaved as though he were crazy.
He was seventy-five or more, and he lived in a corner beyond the apiary in an old decaying
wooden cell which had been built long ago for another great ascetic, Father Yona, who
had lived to be a hundred and five, and of whose saintly doings many curious stories
were still extant in the monastery and the neighborhood.
